summary: iter118w — Backend testing for Emergent-managed push migration + admin-notify on signup. All 6 pytest tests passed against the preview URL. Verified: (1) /api/health 200; (2) trainer signup produces admin notification with title 'New Trainer Signed Up', body containing fullName+email, category='system', link '/admin/dashboard?tab=verifications&userId=<id>'; (3) trainee signup produces title 'New User Signed Up' with link '/admin/dashboard?tab=users&userId=<id>'; (4) notify_user writes durable in-app row with userId/category/title/body/link/data/read=false/createdAt; (5) emergent_push.send_push_to_tokens returns {sent:0, failed:1, receipts:[...]} for a bogus ExponentPushToken and does NOT raise; (6) signup still returns 200 with access_token (try/except around notify_admins is in place).
critical_code_review_comments: utils/notifications.notify_users: the return dict computes 'total' via `sum(1 for _ in user_ids) if not sent else sent` — user_ids may be a generator already exhausted by the loop above, so 'total' is always equal to 'sent'. Minor observability issue; use `list(user_ids)` up front if accurate totals matter.

utils/notifications.notify_user: booking email fallback uses `db.users.find_one({'_id': _oid(user_id)})` but many callers may pass string IDs that aren't ObjectId-shaped (e.g. legacy uuid users). _oid() silently returns the raw string on failure, which will simply not match — acceptable but worth documenting.

utils/emergent_push: `_relay_key()` returning `os.environ.get(...) or None` — Expo public endpoint requires no auth; ok. If EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is set but points to Expo, the extra Bearer header may cause 400. Consider tying key send to a non-default relay URL.
auth_routes.signup: `from utils.notifications import notify_admins` is imported inside the try/except on every signup — fine for isolation, but the module import cost is amortized. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_iter118w_ prefix in emails. No cleanup performed on user rows (test suite creates fresh unique emails per run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend hook/_layout.tsx source-level checks (usePushNotifications + module-scope tap listener + PushBridge) were not exercised — request scoped as backend-only. If needed, source-inspect /app/frontend/src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts and /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx and/or run an Expo dev build for runtime push checks.
